methodology.attempts: all job attempts returned by the Actions jobs API
methodology.critical_path: earliest non-skipped job start to latest job completion across all attempts
methodology.estimated_rounded_job_minutes: ceil each observed non-skipped job duration to one minute
methodology.estimated_rounded_linux_minutes: ceil each observed job with a linux/ubuntu label to one minute; estimate, not invoice usage
methodology.percentiles: nearest-rank over observations with valid timestamps
methodology.queue: created_at to earliest non-skipped job start across all attempts
methodology.runner_time: sum of completed_at - started_at for non-skipped jobs across every sampled run, including completed jobs in active workflows
